children: GAA Living, a major provider of strategic consulting services for the rental living sector, is boosting its regional presence with offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi that will focus on sharing its services with clients in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

Responding to growing demand for GAA Living’s rental living advisory services, the sector-specialist consultancy today (September 16) announced its expansion into the Middle East and the opening of a new headquarters in London’s West End.

GAA Living’s Head of Middle East, Romain Achi, will be located across Dubai and Abu Dhabi with an initial focus on sharing GAA Living’s services with clients in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, said the company in a statement.

Romain will also be responsible for all activity across the wider APAC region with the new Middle East foothold marking an important milestone in GAA Living’s growth and strengthening of its presence across the globe.

This expansion allows GAA Living to be closer to its global clients and partners, better understand the needs of the region, and deliver the high-quality service and expertise the award-winning consultancy is known for, it added.
The firm today announced opening its new headquarters at 55 Wells Street, London, W1.

"Our new West End headquarters, together with our new Middle East presence is a pivotal moment for GAA Living’s long-term growth strategy and reinforces our commitment to serving clients across key global markets and attracting exceptional talent," remarked Ronak Rawal, Senior Director, GAA Living.

GAA Living said it was already working with a number of clients across the Middle East and looking forward to building new relationships, supporting existing clients, and contributing to the region’s dynamic business community.

"We have seen growing demand for our rental living consultancy services as the sector develops in the Middle East," stated Romain Achi. "With our new local presence, we will be even better placed to serve our valued clients in the region," he added.

title: ZAWYA: GAA Living boosts Middle East presence with new Dubai, Abu Dhabi offices
